5:82: A ţţafeḍ icenga iqeṣḥanen maḍi, n wid iumnen, d udayen akked wid iţcaraken. A ţţafeḍ wid iqeṛben maḍi, s lmaḥnana, ar wid iumnen, d wid innan: "nekwni d imasiḥiyen". Ayagi, acku llan degsen ixelwiyen, iṛehbaniyen, u nitni ur smeɣwṛen ara iman nnsen.
5:83: Ma slan i wayen id iusan ar Umazan, a ţwaliḍ allen nnsen ččuṛent d imeṭṭi, seg wayen ufan n tideţ. Qqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Numen, Aru yaɣ seg inagan.
5:84: Acu i ɣ iuɣen ur numin s Ṛebbi akked wayen i ɣ d iusan n tideţ; ur nessarem a ɣ Issekcem, Mass nneɣ, s agdud iɛaṛḍiyen"?
5:85: A ten Ioazi Ṛebbi, ɣef wayen d qqaṛen, s leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. Wagi d aoazi n lɛuṣam.
5:86: Wid ijehlen, u skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, widak, d at Loahennama.
5:87: A wid iumnen! Ur ţgeddilet ayen imaɛnen i wen Iḥell Ṛebbi. Ur zegret tilas. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
5:88: Eččet seg wayen ikwen Iṛẓeq Ṛebbi, iḥellen, imaɛnen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. YiS, kunwi, ay tumnem.
5:89: Ur kwen Iţqassa Ṛebbi ɣef tgallit n tkerkas. Maca, a kwen Iqiss ɣef tgallit n ṣṣeḥ. Takweffaṛt is: a ţţecceččem mraw imeɣban, akken tecceččam tawacult nnwen, neɣ a ten tesselsem, neɣ a ţserḥem i wakli. Win ur nwɛa ara, ad iuẓum kraḍ wussan. D tagi ay d takweffaṛt n tgallit nnwen, ma teggullem. Eṭṭfet di tgallit nnwen. Akka i wen d Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
5:90: A wid iumnen! Ccṛab, leqwmeṛ, tiɛancuṛin, taseqqaṛt, d ayen kan icemten, seg igi n Cciṭan. Ihi, ḍeṛṛeft asen, amar a ţrebḥem.
5:91: Ibɣa kan Cciṭan ad isker ticenga akked ddɣel garawen, s ccṛab akked leqwmeṛ, a kwen iḍeṛṛef seg usmekti n Ṛebbi, akked tẓallit. Day ur teţfukkum ara?
5:92: Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi, aɣet awal i Umazan. ɣuṛwat! Ma twexxṛem, cfut ar Amazan, iwata yas kan anabi iţbegginen.
5:93: Ur telli tiyta deg wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ɣef wayen ččan, ma ḥezzben, umnen, xedmen ayen ilhan, sinna ḥezzben, umnen, sinna, ḥezzben u maɛnen. Ṛebbi Iḥemmel lɛuṣam.
5:94: A wid iumnen! War ccekk, a kwen Iweddeb Ṛebbi ɣef wayen teţṣeggidem s ifassen nnwen, u s ixtucen nnwen, iwakken ad Iẓeṛ Ṛebbi anwa i T iţţagwaden, di tbaḍnit. Win izegren tilas, deffir waya, fellas aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
5:95: A wid iumnen! Ur ţṣeggidet di zzyaṛa nnwen. Win iṣeggden segwen, u iɛammed, aqeṭṭi: ad iseddeq, si lmal is, ayen inɣa s ṣṣyada s, a d ḥudden, f waya, sin irgazen iḥesbiyen segwen. D tikci ara iawḍen ar Lkaɛba. Neɣ takweffaṛt: ad iccečč imeɣban, neɣ, ayen iswan aya, ad iuẓum. Ad ijeṛṛeb ḍḍeṛṛ n lameṛ is. Ṛebbi Isemmeḥ i wayen iɛaddan. Win iuɣalen a d Irr Ṛebbi segs ţţaṛ. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Iţţara d ţţaṛ.
5:96: Tḥell awen ṣṣyada n yill akked učči s. D lqut i kunwi akw iminigen. Teţwagdel awen ṣṣyada di tmurt, skud aql akwen d zziyyaṛ. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, ɣuṛeS ara teţwafesrem.
5:97: Irra Ṛebbi Lkaɛba d axxam iṛqan iţwabnan i lɣaci, aggur iṛqan, asfel, isenoaq, ayagi iwakken a ţţeẓṛem ar Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg igenwan u di tmurt, u Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
5:98: Cfut iwɛaṛ uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
5:99: Amazan, iwata yas kan unabi. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen temmalem u ayen teţţeffrem.
5:100: Ini: "ur iaɛdil ara wayen n dir akked wayen imaɛnen", xas teswehm ik lkwetṛa n wayen n dir. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, a yuɛqilen, amar a ţrebḥem.
5:101: A wid iumnen! Ur steqsayet ɣef tɣawsiwin ara kwen icweɣben, ma mlan awen tent. Ma testeqsam fellasent mara d iţrusu Leqwṛan, ad awen ţţufessrent. Ṛebbi Isemmeḥ aya. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iḥellem.
5:102: Niɣ isteqsa fellasent ugdud, uqbel nnwen. Sinna, segsent, gwran d d ijehliyen.
5:103: Ur d Ifki Ṛebbi Baḥiṛa, neɣ Sayba, neɣ Waṣila, neɣ Ḥami. Maca, wid ijehlen gren d tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi. Tegwti degsen ur fhimen.
5:104: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw ar wayen id Issers Ṛebbi, u ar Umazan". Qqaṛen: "beṛka yaɣ ayen id nufa, ɣef waya, ɣeṛ imezwura nneɣ". I ma imezwura nnsen ur ssinen acemma, ur ţwanhan?
5:105: A wid iumnen! Fellawen iman nnwen. Ur kwen iṭṭuṛṛu win innetlafen, ma teţwanham. Ar Ṛebbi, tuɣalin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
5:106: A wid iumnen! Ccada garawen, ma tusa d tmeţţant ar yiwen segwen. Di lawan uweṣṣi, sin irgazen iḥesbiyen, segwen, neɣ wiyaḍ war segwen, ma tellam d iminigen di tmurt, u tusa kwen id twaɣit n tmeţţant. A ten qesden deffir tẓallit. Ma tcukkem, sgallet ţen s Ṛebbi: "ur d nesfayday syis, xas iaɛna llzem nneɣ, ur nteffer ccada n Ṛebbi, mulac, nekwni a nili seg imednab".
5:107: Ma iḍehṛ ed fellasen denben, ad ţţuneṣfen s wiyaḍ, si loiha n wid ḍuṛṛen imezwura. Ad ggalen s Ṛebbi: "ih, ccada nneɣ tif ccada nnsen. Ur nzegger tilas, mulac, war ccekk, a nili seg imednas".
5:108: Pţif akka iwakken a d awin ccada iwulmen, ad agwaden a ţţili tgallit deffir tgallit nnsen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, ssemḥesset, Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballaɣen.
5:109: Ass ideg ara Issemlil Ṛebbi imazanen, ad Yini: "acu i wen d jawben"? Ad inin: "ur telli tussna ɣuṛneɣ. D Kečč, s tideţ, i Issnen tibaḍniyin".
5:110: Mi Inna Ṛebbi: "a Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem! Mmekti d i kwen ɣɣateɣ, kečč akked imma k, mi k Ɛiwneɣ s ṛṛuḥ iṛqan. Teţmmeslayeḍ i medden si dduḥ, am unqaqṛi. Mi k Slemdeɣ Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, Tuṛa, Linoil. Mi tṣenɛaḍ, si talaxt, ṣṣifa n ufrux, s– tsriḥ iW; tṣuḍeḍ degs, tuɣal d afṛux, s– tsriḥ iW. Tesseḥlayeḍ agugam, amuḍin n lberṣ, s– tsriḥ iW. Mi tessenkareḍ lmeggtin, s– tsriḥ iW. Mi Sbaɛdeɣ fellak At Isṛail, mi d tusiḍ ɣuṛsen, s ubeggen, u nnan wid ijehlen segsen: "ayagi iban d ssḥur kan".
5:111: Mi Weḥḥaɣ i inmahalen: "amnet yissI, akw s umazan iW". Nnan: "numen. Echhed ar nekwni d imḍuɛen".
5:112: Mi nnan inmahalen: "a Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem! Ma Izmer Mass ik ad aɣ d Issers lmaida seg igenni"? Inna: "ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
5:113: Nnan: "nebɣa a nečč segs, a neḍmen ulawen nneɣ, a nẓeṛ ar tenniḍ aɣ d tideţ, a nili d inagan iS".
5:114: Inna Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem: "a Ṛebbi, Mass nneɣ, Ssers aɣ d lmaida, seg igenni, ad aɣ tili d lɛid i umezwaru u i uneggaru nneɣ, u d assekni s ɣuṛeK. ɣit aɣ d. Kečč, Tifeḍ akw imɣiten".
5:115: Inna Ṛebbi: "ad awen ţ id Sserseɣ. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, a t Ɛaqbeɣ aɛaqeb ur Sɛaddaɣ i yiwen deg imaḍalen".
5:116: Mi Inna Ṛebbi: "a Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem! D kečč i innan i lɣaci: erret aɣ, nek akked imma, d sin iṛebbiten war Ṛebbi"? Inna: "gedha s yiseK! Ur iyi iţţunefk ara a d iniɣ ayen iɣef ur sɛiɣ lḥeqq. Lemmer i t id nniɣ, yili Teẓṛiḍ t. Tesneḍ i illan deg iman iw, ur ssineɣ ayen illan deg iman iK. Kečč, s tideţ, d Amusnaw n tbaḍniyin.
5:117: I asen nniɣ, siwa ayen iyi d Tumṛeḍ: ɛabdet Ṛebbi, Mass iw, u Mass nnwen. Lliɣ d anagi nnsen, skud lliɣ garasen. Mi iyi n Tessuliḍ ɣuṛeK, d Kečč i ten id Iquṛɛan. Kečč, d Anagi n yal cci.
5:118: Ma Tɛaqbeḍ ten, niɣ d imdanen iK, ma Tsemmḥeḍ asen, Kečč, s tideţ, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab".
5:119: Inna Ṛebbi: "wagi d ass ideg ara stenfɛan imawlan n tideţ, si tideţ nnsen. I nitni leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, ad wekkṛen degsen, i lebda". Iṛuḍa ten Ṛebbi, u ṛuḍan T, d wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
5:120: N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen. Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
6:1: A neckeṛ Ṛebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan. Irra tillas, tafat. Sinna, wid ijehlen ţţaran tanudda i Mass nnsen.
6:2: Neţţa, ikwen Ixelqen s talaxt, sinna, Iseyya lajel. ɣuṛeS lajel iţwassnen. Deffir waya, kunwi la teţcukkum.
6:3: Neţţa, d Ṛebbi deg igenwan, di tmurt. Issen sser nnwen, d wayen d teqqaṛem. Iẓṛa ayen tkesbem.
6:4: Ur ten id iţţas ussekni seg issekniyen n Mass nnsen, mebla ma ugin t.
6:5: Niɣ skaddben tideţ, mi ten id tusa. A ten id ias usali n wayen iɣef ttihin.
6:6: Day ur walan ara acḥal isuta, uqbel nnsen, ay Nekkes. Nesserked iten di tmurt akken ur kwen Nesserked. Nuzen asen aṭas ugeffur, Nerra yasen isaffen, ţţazzalen seddawat sen. Nesnegr iten ilmend ibekkaḍen nnsen. Nxelq ed, deffir sen, sself nniḍen.
6:7: Xas ad ak ed Nessers Tazmamt, di lkaɣeḍ, ara nnalen s ifassen nnsen, war ccekk, a d inin wid ijehlen: "wagi, s tideţ, siwa ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ".
6:8: Qqaṛen: "a lemmer id irs ɣuṛes lmelk". Lemmer a n Nessers lmelk, war ccekk, ad iṣaṛ lameṛ, sinna, ur ţganin.
6:9: Lemmer i t Nerri d lmelk, yili Nerra t d argaz, ad as Nessels ayen ţlusun.
6:10: Niɣ mmaɛlken ɣef imazanen, uqbel ik. Ayen iɣef ttihin, izzi i wid, segsen, immaɛlken.
6:11: Ini: "ddut di tmurt, sinna walit amek teḍṛa d wid iskiddiben".
6:12: Ini: "w i t ilan wayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Ṛebbi". Iura, deg iman iS, aḥunu. A kwen Issemlil i wass n tnekra, ur ccekk fellas. Wid isxesṛen iman nnsen, ur ţţamnen.
6:13: IneS i izedɣen deg iḍ, deg wass. Neţţa Issel, d Amusnaw.
6:14: Ini: "day ara sɛuɣ bab, war Ṛebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Neţţa Icceččay ur t cceččayen". Ini: "nek ţwamṛeɣ d ad iliɣ d amenzu ara ianzen. Ur ţţilit seg imcurak".
6:15: Ini: "nek ugadeɣ, ma aɛṣaɣ Mass iw, aɛaqeb n wass ameqwṛaḥan".
6:16: Win imenɛan segs, assen, niɣ Iḥun fellas. Wagi d rrebḥ n ṣṣeḥ.
6:17: Ma Isɛadda Ṛebbi fellak cedda, ur ţ itekkes yiwen, siwa Neţţa. Ma Isrebḥ ik, Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
6:18: D Neţţa ay d Aqehhaṛ, sennig imdanen iS; d Neţţa ay d Bab n ṣṣwab, i Iẓṛan.
6:19: Ini: "anda ţ ccada sennig akw tiyaḍ"? Ini: "Ṛebbi d Anagi gari yidwen. Iweḥḥa yi d Leqwṛan agi, iwakken a kwen nabiɣ yis, kunwi akked wid uɣuṛ ibbweḍ. Day, kunwi, war ccekk, a ţcehhdem ar, ar tama n Ṛebbi, llan iṛebbiten nniḍen"? Ini: "ur cehhdeɣ"! Ini: "Neţţa d Ṛebbi, siwa Yiwen. Nek, rriɣ akin ayen teţcarakem".
6:20: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ssnen ţ, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. Wid isxesṛen iman nnsen, ihi, ur ţţamnen.
6:21: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, neɣ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebḥen imednas.
6:22: Ass ideg ara ten Nefser meṛṛa, sinna a Nini i wid icurken: "anda ten icriken nnwen, i la tɛabdem"?
6:23: Deg uhewwel nnsen, siwa ma nnan d: "s Ṛebbi, Mass nneɣ, ur nelli d imcurak"!
6:24: Wali amek skaddben ɣef yiman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen la d snulfuyen.
6:25: Garasen wid i k issemḥasen. Nerra aḥurrim ɣef ulawen nnsen, iwakken ur t fehmen. Tiɛẓẓegt deg imeẓẓuɣen nnsen. Ma walan yal assekni, ur ţţamnen yis. Alamma, ma usan d ɣuṛek, a k namren, ad ak inin wid ijehlen: ayagi siwa tiḥkayin imezwura.
6:26: Sṭixxiṛen segs, ṭṭeṛṛifen segs. Ay squccun siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
6:27: Lemmer a ten twaliḍ, mara bedden ar tmes, a d inin: a ssexḍ nneɣ! Awi ɣ irran, ur neskiddib issekniyen n Mass nneɣ! A nili si lmumnin.
6:28: Xaṭi! Iban asen d wayen teffren, zik. Lemmer a d kren, ad uɣalen ar wayen i sen iţwagedlen. Nitni, s tideţ, d ikeddaben.
6:29: U qqaṛen: "siwa tameddurt n ddunit i illan. Nekwni, ur fellaɣ tanekra".
6:30: Lemmer a ţwaliḍ mara bedden ar Mass nnsen, ad Yini: "niɣ ayagi s tideţ"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nneɣ"! Ad Yini: "ihi jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb, ilmend n wayen tejhilem".
6:31: Niɣ xesṛen wid iskaddben timlilit akked Ṛebbi. Alamma, ma iusa ten id yimir, deqzalla, a d inin: "a yamxix nneɣ, ɣef wayen ideg nestehza"! Nitni ad bibben tiɛakkwumin nnsen ɣef izugar nnsen. I icmet wayen bubben!
6:32: Tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan akked lhawiyya. Axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, yif iţ i wid iţḥezziben. Day ur teţmeyyizem ara?
6:33: Niɣ Neẓṛa iɣwebben ik, s tideţ, wayen qqaṛen. Ihi, nitni ur k skiddiben. Maca imednas ḍeggṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi.
6:34: Niɣ skaddben imazanen uqbel ik. Ṣebṛen ɣef wayen i ten skaddben, akked wayen i ten meḥḥnen, armi i ten id iusa usellek nneɣ. Ur illi ubeddel i wawalen n Ṛebbi. Niɣ usan k id, kra isallen imazanen.
6:35: Ma ẓẓay fellak uwexxeṛ nnsen, ma tzemṛeḍ a tessarmeḍ aderbuz di tmurt, neɣ sellum s igenni, ad asen d tawiḍ assekni. Ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi, a ten Issemlil ar nnhaya. Ur ţţili seg wid ur nessin.
6:36: Siwa wid isellen, ara d ijawben. Lmegtin a ten id Issker Ṛebbi, sinna, ɣuṛeS tuɣalin nnsen.
6:37: Qqaṛen: "acimi ur as d irs ara ussekni sɣuṛ Mass is"? Ini: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer a d Issers assekni", maca tegwti degsen ur ẓṛin.
6:38: Ur illi lweḥc di tmurt, neɣ ufrux iţţafgen s wafriwen is, ur nelli d leoyus am kunwi. Ur Nestehza, di Tezmamt, ɣef wacemma. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, ad ţwafessren.
6:39: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, ɛaẓgen, gugmen, di tillas. Win i S ihwan i Ṛebbi, a t Itlef. Win i S ihwan, a t Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
6:40: Ini: "twalam ma iusa kwen id uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi, neɣ ma iusa kwen id yimir, day ar war Ṛebbi ara tnaɛṛem, ma tessawalem tideţ?
6:41: Xaṭi! ɣuṛeS ara tnujem. Ad Issiferr ayen iɣef tnujem ɣuṛeS, ma ihwa yaS, a ţţeţţum ayen tcurkem".
6:42: Niɣ Nuzen ed ar leoyus, uqbel ik. Nesɛadda fellasen tilufa, ccqa, amar ad ḥiwten.
6:43: A lemmer ḥawten, mi ten id tusa tiyta nneɣ. Maca, qehṛen wulawen nnsen. Cciṭan Icebbeḥ asen ayen xeddmen.
6:44: Mi ţţun ayen i sen d smmektin, Nelli yasen tibbura n yal cci, armi, mi feṛḥen s wayen i sen iţţunefken, Newwet iten, deqzalla. Dɣa qeḍɛen layas.
6:45: Pwakksen wid id igwran seg ugdud idensen. Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
6:46: Ini: "twalam, ma Iddem awen Ṛebbi timesliwt nnwen, akked iẓṛi nnwen; ma Isleɣ ulawen nnwen; anwa ṛebbi, war Ṛebbi, ar awen ten id iawin"? Wali amek Nessefham issekniyen, u nitni, sinna, zzin akin.
6:47: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi, deqzalla, neɣ ɛinani? Day ara Ineɣ, siwa agdud imednas"?
6:48: Ur d Nuzen imazanen, siwa i ubecceṛ, d unabi. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
6:49: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, a ten iḥaz uɛaqeb, ilmend n wayen beɣwḍen.
6:50: Ini: "ur awen qqareɣ sɛiɣ igerrujen n Ṛebbi, ur ssineɣ tabaḍnit; ur awen qqareɣ: nek, d lmelk. Nek, tedduɣ kan akked wayen iyi d iţţuweḥḥan". Ini: "day iaɛdel uderɣal d win iţwalin? Day ur d teţmeyyizem ara"?
6:51: Nabi yis wid iugaden ad ţwafessren ar Mass nnsen. Ur sɛin bab, war Neţţa, neɣ amcafaɛ. Amar ad ḥezzben.
6:52: Ur ţţara wid iţnujun ɣuṛ Mass nnsen, taṣebḥit, tameddit, ţnadin udem iS. Ur fellak a ten tḥasbeḍ deg wacemma, ur fellasen a k ḥasben, deg wacemma. Ma terriḍ ten, ihi, a ţţiliḍ seg imednas.
6:53: Akka ay Nhewwel kra s wiyaḍ, iwakken a d inin: "day d wigi i Iɣat Ṛebbi, garaneɣ"? Day ur Issin ara Ṛebbi, sennig akw, wid isnemmiren?
6:54: Ma usan k id wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ, ini: "tifrat fellawen"! Mass nnwen Iura, i iman iS, aḥunu. Ihi, i win, segwen, ixedmen tucmiţ, ur iɛammed, sin akin, isteṛoaɛ, u ixdem ayen ilhan, Neţţa Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
6:55: Akka ay Nfeṣṣel issekniyen, iwakken a d iban ubrid ibeɣwḍiyen.
6:56: Ini: "nek, iţţugdel iyi ad ɛabdeɣ wid uɣuṛ la teţnujum, war Ṛebbi". Ini: "ur tedduɣ d lemcihwat nnwen, mulac ad nnetlafeɣ, ur ţţiliɣ seg wid iţwanhan".
6:57: Ini: "nek, ṭṭfeɣ deg ubeggen n Mass iw. Teskaddbem t. Ur illi ɣuṛi wayen uɣuṛ tḥarem. Ih, aḥuddu ɣeṛ Ṛebbi kan. Issawal tideţ. Neţţa Yif akw wid issenqaden".
6:58: Ini: "lemmer illi ɣuṛi wayen uɣuṛ tḥarem, yili iṣaṛ lameṛ, gari yidwen". Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen imednas.
6:59: ɣuṛeS tisura n tbaḍnit. Siwa Neţţa itent Issnen. Iẓṛa i illan di lberr, di yill. Ur iɣelli ifer siwa ma Iẓṛa t. Akken aɛqqa di tillas n tmurt, tizzegzewt, taɣeṛt, akw di tezmamt iţbegginen.
6:60: D Neţţa i wen iţţaddamen leṛwaḥ deg iḍ. Iẓṛa ay txeddmem, deg wass. Sinna, Iţţara kwen id degs, iwakken ad iḍṛu lajel iţwassnen. Sinna, ɣuṛeS tuɣalin nnwen, sinna, a kwen Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
6:61: D Neţţa ay d Aqehhaṛ sennig imdanen iS. Iţţazen ed ɣuṛwen imḥaraben, alamma, ma tusa d tmeţţant ar yiwen segwen, ad ddmen ṛṛuḥ is, imceggɛen nneɣ. Nitni ur stehzayen.
6:62: Sinna, ad uɣalen ar Ṛebbi, Bab nnsen n tideţ. Aḥuddu, day mačči d ayla S? Neţţa Yif akw akken Iţɣawal ar uqeṭṭi.
6:63: Ini: "anwa ara kwen Isellken si tillas n lberr d yill, uɣuṛ tnujem s uḥiwet akked tugwdi"? "Ma Isellek aɣ si tagi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
6:64: Ini: "Ṛebbi Isellek ikwen segs, akw si yal lhemm, sinna, kunwi la teţcarakem".
6:65: Ini: "Neţţa, Izmer ad awen d Iazen aɛaqeb sennig wen, neɣ seddaw iḍaṛen nnwen. Neɣ a kwen Issemfaṛaq, kra segwen ad jeṛṛben leqheṛ n wiyaḍ". Wali amek id Nemmal issekniyen, amar ad meḥṣen.
6:66: Iskaddeb it ugdud ik, u neţţa d tideţ. Ini: "ur awen lliɣ d awkil.
6:67: Yal asali s lweqt is. A ţţuɣalem a ţţeẓṛem".
6:68: Ma twalaḍ wid iţnamaren ɣef issekniyen nneɣ, eoo iten, alamma bedlen anamer. Ma iseţţu k Cciṭan, mi d temmektiḍ, ur ţɣimi d ugdud imednas.
6:69: Ur isefk ara i wid iţḥezziben, a ten ḥasben deg wacemma. Maca d asmekti, amar ad ḥezzben.
6:70: Eoo wid irran ddin nnsen d urar, d aqesseṛ. Tɣuṛṛ iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Mmekti d yis, ard a iţwaṭṭef umdan ɣef wayen ikseb. Ur isɛi, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ amcafaɛ. Yal leɣṛama ur teţwaqbal segs. Widak d wid iţwaṭfen ɣef wayen kesben. I nitni tissit iṛɣan, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan, ilmend n wayen la jehlen.
6:71: Ini: "day a nɛaṛ, war Ṛebbi, ayen ur aɣ neneffaɛ, ur aɣ neṭṭuṛṛu? U a nuɣal a nwexxeṛ, deffir nnhaya n Ṛebbi, am win ɣewwan ccwaṭen di tmurt, u iţţuḥeyyeṛ". Pnecciden t imeddukwal ar nnhaya: "yya ɣuṛneɣ"! Ini: "d nnhaya n Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ay d nnhaya. Neţwameṛ a nanez i Mass imaḍalen".
6:72: Ẓẓalet, ḥezzbet aS. ɣuṛeS, Neţţa, ara teţwafessrem.
6:73: D Neţţa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ. Ass ideg ara Yini: "ili"! Ad yili. Awal iS d tideţ. IneS tagelda. Ass uṣuḍu n lbuq, Iẓṛa i iffren d wayen iḍehṛen. Neţţa d Bab n ṣṣwab, i Iẓṛan.
6:74: Mi inna Ibṛahim i baba s, Azaṛ: "day a ţţerreḍ tiɛancuṛin d iṛebbiten? Nek walaɣ k, kečč akked ugdud ik, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ".
6:75: Akka, Nessken i Ibṛahim, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, iwakken ad yili seg wid itebbten.
6:76: Mi t iɣumm yiḍ, iwala itri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi ixsi, inna: "ur ḥemleɣ ara wid ixessin".
6:77: Mi iwala iuli d waggur n tziri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi iɣab, inna: "ma ur iyi Inha ara Mass iw, ad iliɣ, war ccekk, seg ugdud imɣeṛṛqen".
6:78: Mi iwala iṭij ineqqeṛ ed, inna: "wagi d Mass iw, wagi meqqweṛ kteṛ". Mi iɣli, inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek rriɣ akkin ayen teţcarakem.
6:79: Nek zziɣ udem iw ar Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, maleɣ ar tideţ. Ur lliɣ, nek, seg imcurak".
6:80: Ixuṣem it ugdud is, inna: "day ad iyi txaṣmem ɣef Ṛebbi? Niɣ Inha yi; ur ugadeɣ ayen i S tcurkem, siwa ma illa wayen i S ihwan i Mass iw. Tussna n Mass iw tezdi yal cci, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
6:81: Amek ara ugadeɣ ayen teţcarakem, ur tugadem mi kunwi teţcarakem, i Ṛebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu fellawen? Anwa, ger sin ikabaran, i iklalen laman, maday tessnem"?
6:82: Wid iumnen, ur sselsen ddens i liman nnsen, widak ad ilin di laman, u nitni ţwanhan.
6:83: D wagi ay d awal nneɣ. Nefka yas t i Ibṛahim, mgal agdud is. Nessalay tiseddaṛin, win iɣ ɣ ihwan. Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
6:84: Nefka yas Isḥaq akked Yaɛqub. I sin, Nenha ten. Nenha, zik, Nuḥ akw, ger tarwa s, Dawed, Sliman, Yub, Yusef, Musa, Haṛun, - Akka ay Neţkafi iɛaṛḍiyen -
6:85: Zakarya, Yeḥya, Ɛisa, Ilyas, - akw seg iɛaṛḍiyen -
6:86: Ismaɛil, Lyasɛa, Yunes, Luṭ, - akw Nesmenyaf iten ɣef imaḍalen -
6:87: akw seg ibabaten nnsen, si tarwa nnsen, akked watmaten nnsen. Nefren iten, u Nebbwi ten d ubrid uwqim.
6:88: Tagi d nnhaya n Ṛebbi. Inehhu yis win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Lemmer curken, war ccekk, ad asen imḥu wayen xeddmen.
6:89: D wigi iwumi d Nebbwi Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, akked lambiyya. Ma jehlen widak yis, ihi, Nekwni Nwekkel iţ i ugdud ur njehhel yis.
6:90: Wigi d wid Inha Ṛebbi. Ddu d nnhaya nnsen. Ini: "ur awen sutureɣ, fellas, taqdiɛt. Neţţa d asmekti kan i imaḍalen".
6:91: Ur qudṛen Ṛebbi azal n lqedṛ iS, mi qqaṛen: "ur d Issers Ṛebbi acemma ar umdan". Ini: "anwa id Issersen Tazmamt, id ibbwi Musa, d tafat u d nnhaya i medden? Teţţaram ţ di lkwaɣeḍ i tesskanem. Aṭas ay teţţeffrem. Tlemdem ayen ur tessinem, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen". Ini: "D Ṛebbi". Sinna, anef asen ad uraren s nnmara nnsen.
6:92: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers iţ id teṛqa, a ţtebbet ayen iţ id izwaren, a ţţendeṛ tayimmaţ n temdinin akked wayen i s d izzin. Wid iumnen s laxeṛt, umnen yis. Nitni bedden i tẓilla nnsen.
6:93: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi? Neɣ inna: "ţţuweḥḥaɣ d", ur as d iţţuweḥḥa wacemma? U win innan: "a d sserseɣ am wayen id Issers Ṛebbi"? Lemmer a ţwaliḍ imednas, di maylellif n tmeţţant, u lmalayek ẓlent ed ifassen nnsent: "ssuffɣet ed tiṛwiḥin nnwen. Assa, a ţţeţţuqeṭṭim s uɛaqeb isneḥcamen, ilmend n wayen teqqaṛem ɣef Ṛebbi, ur d tideţ. U tellam tessemɣwaṛem iman nnwen, ɣef issekniyen iS".
6:94: Niɣ tusam aɣ d, d ifṛiden, akken ikwen Nexleq abrid amezwaru. Teooam deffir wen, ayen i wen Nefka. Ur Nwala, ɣuṛwen, imcafɛen nnwen, wid i tɛabdem, nitni, d icriken nnwen. Niɣ temfaṛaqem, u ooan kwen wid la tɛabdem.
6:95: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ifeṛṛec aɛqqa, iɣes. Issuffuɣ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffuɣ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Akka ay d Ṛebbi. Acimi tugim?
6:96: Issenkar tafrara. Irra iḍ i ureyyeḥ, iṭij d waggur i leḥsab. D wagi ay d aseyyi n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
6:97: D Neţţa i wen Irran itran, ad awen mlen abrid, di tillas n lberr akked yill. Niɣ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
6:98: D Neţţa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiman afṛid, sinna: amkan, tarusi. Niɣ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud ifehhmen.
6:99: D Neţţa id Isrusun aman seg igenni. Nessuffuɣ ed yissen yal imɣan. Nessuffuɣ ed yissen tizzegzewt. Nessuffuɣ ed yissen iɛaqqayen mbabben, iguza n ţţmeṛ id iţṣubbun si tezdayin, leonanat n tfeṛṛant, uzemmur, n ṛemman, ţţemcabin neɣ ur ţţemcabin. Walit ţţemṛa nnsen mi d teffeɣ tebbwa. Ih, deg waya, war ccekk, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
6:100: Rran i Ṛebbi, leonun d icriken, u Ixelq iten. Snulfan aS d arrac, tullas, ur ẓṛin. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aɛlay sennig wayen d qqaṛen!
6:101: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, amek ara Isɛu mmi S, ur Isɛi tameddakwelt? U Ixleq yal cci, u Neţţa, yal cci, Issen it.
6:102: D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Ixleq yal cci, ihi ɛabdet eP. Neţţa d Awkil n yal cci.
6:103: Ur T teţsami tmuɣli. Neţţa Iţsami tamuɣli. Neţţa d Laṭif, i Izṛan.
6:104: Niɣ iusa kwen id ara twalim, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Win iwalan, i iman is; win idreɣlen, mgal is. Ur lliɣ nek d amḥareb nnwen.
6:105: Akka ay Nessefham issekniyen, iwakken ad inin: "tlemdeḍ", iwakken a t Nbeggen i ugdud issnen.
6:106: Ddu d wayen ik ed iţţuweḥḥan, sɣuṛ Mass ik; ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Eoo imcurak.
6:107: Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur curken. Ur k Nerra d amḥareb nnsen, ur telliḍ d awkil nnsen.
6:108: Ur naɛlet wid uɣuṛ la ţnujun, war Ṛebbi. Axaṭeṛ ad naɛlen Ṛebbi, s lbeɣwḍ, war tamusni. Akka ay Ncebbeḥ igiten is i yal lois. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, tuɣalin nnsen; a ten Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen xeddmen.
6:109: Ggulen s Ṛebbi, tagalit meqqwṛen, ar ma iusa ten id ussekni, ar ad amnen yis. Ini: "issekniyen ar Ṛebbi kan". Acu i kwen irran tḥussem ar, xas ma iusa ten id, ur ţţamnen?
6:110: A Neţţi ulawen nnsen, d yiẓṛi nnsen, akken ur uminen yis abrid amezwaru. A ten Neoo di lbeɣwḍ nnsen, d iderɣalen.
